header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “If a person gets up from the place where he was sitting and goes away (for some need), and then returns, he is the most entitled to (sit in) that place.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ اَبِيْهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ ﵄ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: لَا يُجْلَسْ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ اِلَّا بِاِذْنِهِمَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في الرجل يجلس ....رقم:٤٨٤٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Amr ibn Shu'aib (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “One must not sit between two men without the permission of both of them.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ لَعَنَ مَنْ جَلَسَ وَسْطَ الْحَلْقَةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب الجلوس وسط الحلقة رقم:٤٨٢٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Hudhaifah (RA) narrates: “Rasulullah ﷺ cursed the one who sits in the middle of a gathering.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The one who sits in the middle of a gathering means the one who steps over people's necks, goes and sits in the middle. Another meaning may also be taken: when people are sitting facing one another, a person comes and sits in the middle of the gathering and becomes an obstruction, so that some of them cannot see the faces of others.
(Ma'ariful Hadith)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ سَعِيْدِ نِ الْخُدْرِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللهِ وَالْيَوْمِ اْلآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمُ ضَيْفَهُ، قَالَهَا ثَلَاثاً قَالَ: وَمَا كَرَامَةُ الضَّيْفِ يَارَسُوْلَ اللهِ؟ قَالَ: ثَلَاثَةُ اَيَّامٍ فَمَا جَلَسَ بَعْدَ ذلِكَ فَهُوَ عَلَيْهِ صَدَقَةٌ.
